svg.title: Keyring SOC Logging, Correlation and Sentinel Telemetry Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end SOC telemetry pipeline showing the four log sources (Keyring audit events via Logs Ingestion DCR, Azure Key Vault diagnostic audit logs, Entra ID sign-in and PIM logs, and runtime health telemetry), the redaction boundary, Log Analytics correlation keys (KvRequestId, ActorObjectId, SessionRef), ASIM normalisation (vimAuditEventKeyring), and Microsoft Sentinel detections, hunting queries and Azure Monitor alerts.
svg.text: Keyring: SOC Logging, Correlation & Sentinel Telemetry Pipeline
Four correlated telemetry streams · Zero secret leakage (TRACE-verified) · ASIM normalisation & 8 ready-to-enable Sentinel rules
Every layer emits structured, zero-secret events
Browser ClientIp, UserAgent, SessionRef, Reason, Ticket,
pre-Azure refusals, shares & multi-env writes (47 actions)
Ground-truth data plane: SecretGet, SecretSet, Delete,
Purge, KeyRotate — covers Keyring, Portal, CLI & apps
MFA/acrs step-up outcomes, Conditional Access grants,
OBO token issuance & PIM elevation approvals
JSON stdout request lines (method, path, status, ms),
Guaranteed NEVER written to stdout, DCR, or ACS email:
✕ Secret values, typed secret fields & PFX passwords
✕ Entra access/refresh/OBO tokens & Managed ID tokens
✕ Session cookies, CSRF tokens & URL query strings
✕ Descriptions, owner/notify emails & raw Azure errors
Enforced on every PR by tests/no_secrets_in_logs.rs
Write-only sink + 3 deterministic SOC join keys
Managed ID writes gzip batches (5s / 500 rows, 10k queue)
Monitoring Metrics Publisher ONLY · zero read/delete rights
Refuses reveals, copies, shares & key downloads if sink degrades >60s.
Every event writes to stdout first so zero audit records are lost.
Links browser IP, UPN, Reason & Ticket to Key Vault's API call.
Verifies MFA method, device compliance, risk & PIM approval.
Comparing KeyringAudit_CL against Key Vault's own audit log
catches unmatched SecretGet calls or a silenced audit sink.
7. Audit sink gap vs KV logs
Keyring Audit Workbook: reveal trends, actors, denials, health
Log search rules on Key Vault workspace (infra/alerts/access):
Watched secret reads, any purge & refusal bursts (15m)
Admins: sink outage (>5m) & refusal bursts; Vault owners:
watched reads, deletes, bulk edits, PIM use & secret shares
